question: Which allowed CLI procedure should guide this credential step? Choose only from the supplied procedures; none means retain deterministic CLI-first guidance. This selects instructions, never execution permission.

procedures.service_cli: Use the service's authenticated CLI/API first. Check only required account/project metadata; do not retrieve a stored secret unless necessary.
procedures.keychain_lookup: Use the authenticated service CLI first when sufficient. Only if a stored credential is necessary, use credential-access: identify the exact authorized service/account; capture macOS security CLI lookup output privately inside the consuming subprocess. Pass it only through stdin or a process-local child environment. Never print it, put it in argv/files/clipboard, or open Keychain Access. Missing identity or OS consent stops the dependent step.
procedures.keychain_store: Use credential-access: store only the explicitly authorized credential with the macOS security CLI and the existing local credential-management procedure. Keep values out of recorded commands, tool output, files and model inputs. Do not change Keychain ACLs or export credentials into every shell.
procedures.clarify: Stop the dependent credential step until its exact service/account, authorized operation or required human OS consent is known. Continue independent work; never enumerate broader secrets or fall back to the GUI.
